newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki holds up better than others as Dow dips.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki holds up better than others as Dow dips.

text.p: Finnish shares sagged to a lower close although the market rose momentarily to a new life high of 2463.76 right after the opening with strong underlying buying interest, brokers said..
Nokia which closed higher in New York on Tuesday than in Helsinki helped sentiment as other European bourses recoiled from recent high levels, they said.
"Shares could rise tomorrow as demand remained strong today despite the losses on Wall Street," said one. "This has been a quiet day, but the market has held up pretty well," said another.
Although bonds fell slightly, yields were still near historic lows and supported stocks, brokers added.
Nokia closed up 1.30 at 262.50 markka, and trade was active at over 200 million markka.
